VIII." centred, then a question heading in italic, then an italic opening paragraph with a catchword-like marginal mark "Quæstio" and "vitiff" in the right margin. No bottom text.

main_text.p: acres, alios falsos, alios summe frigidos, calidos, humidos, siccos, austeros, astringentes, amaros, alios deniq; venenosis qualitatibus esse praeditos, vt cicutâ, ferulâ, tytimallô, hyoscyamô, quib. saepe homines in famis inclementia vescuntur praenouerit. Sic Gal. ex semiputrido tritico morbû ortû communé afferuit. Ex vitiosæ cereuisiæ potu, quæ ex semiputrido hordeo parata fuerat, vidi vno in loco tempore eodem, multos decubuisse eodé morbo, aliis sic nuspiâ affectis. Aliquot ab hinc annis celebratæ sunt nuptiæ in quedâ pago, in quib. cû carnes ob æstum putrefcere cœpisset, quidâ ex illis, q eas auidius comedissent, decubuerunt, plures verò ex contagione in eundem morbû lapsi perierunt. Proinde cauendû vnicuiq; imprimis est, ne improbi succi cibos vsurpet, vnde tot valetudini vitæq; ipsi incommoda impendent.
main_text.head: AD QVÆST. VIII.
main_text.p: An ciborum natura & potestas ad varia gentium ingenia moresque aliquid conferat? Quæstio vis.

p.i: Admiranda plane gentium populorumq; deprehenduntur ingenia, variique animorum mores. Hos autem temperatu-ram corporis sequi, temperaturam vero consonare spirituum confusione, atque commodera-

page.notes: Page is a faded scan; the marginal note at right and the final catchword "modera-" are doubtful. Several words in the first paragraph are uncertain (e.g. "tritico", "cereuisiæ") and may be misprinted; the margin note "Quæstio vis." is partly illegible.
